runtime_proof.note: Measured read-only against production zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm. No row was written, updated or deleted; no containment setting, kill switch or delivery target was read or touched. These are the exact populations the repaired surfaces render.

queries.name: half the suppressed population records no reason at all
queries.method: read-only SELECT over picks_current_state WHERE status = 'awaiting_approval' OR approval_status = 'pending', partitioned on promotion_status IN ('suppressed','not_eligible') and on whether promotion_reason is null or blank after btrim
queries.result: 21,870 suppressed rows in approval scope; 10,882 with no usable reason; 10,988 with one
queries.significance: This is the measurement that justifies rendering a missing reason as a stated defect rather than an em dash. 49.8% of the suppressed population would have rendered as 'nothing to say here'. The red label does not create this defect; it makes an existing one visible, and its size is why a dash was the wrong choice.

queries.name: the held population is real and had no page of its own
queries.method: read-only SELECT over the same approval scope, counting review_decision = 'hold' — the exact predicate getHeldQueue applies
queries.result: 2,075 held rows out of 21,871 in approval scope
queries.significance: getHeldQueue already computed heldBy, ageHours and holdReason for these 2,075 rows and no surface consumed them. The route named after the held queue was a redirect.

observations.what: the repair is presentational; the underlying data is unchanged
observations.evidence: 0 rows written, updated or deleted. Every file in the diff is under apps/command-center, which reads Supabase directly and writes only through apps/api.

observations.what: provider-dependent capability is deferred, not faked
observations.evidence: promotion_reason is written by the scoring path today. This lane makes no claim about CLV, closing lines or automated grading, all of which remain explicitly deferred.
